doc: D3 regression gate (AWR-05 §4.8, D3-AC-01). Run before merging every D3 work package: python tools/bench/d3/regress_gate.py. Steps run in order; kind = cmd runs argv in cwd, kind = builtin runs a step of the gate script.

steps.doc: D2 Python test suite (item 1; F-114, K14), run by tests/d3/regress_gate/d2_suite.py: one full pytest run, then every failed case alone in a fresh pytest process, up to 3 isolated reruns; the step passes when the full run ends normally (exit 0 or 1, no collection or session error), at most 8 cases failed and each of them passed in an isolated rerun (listed as load_sensitive in the D2-SUITE-REPORT line of pytest.log). The isolated rerun covers the wall-clock D2 cases (async timeouts, debounce windows, the perf-lock yield count) that fail now and then in the shared dmax CPU pool under the --cpus quota and behave the same on the D2 tag (K14 record). tests/d3 is not part of this step: it needs the D3 dependencies, Node 22 and navsvc, and runs in the D3 test entry (tools/deploy/dmax/run_d3_tests.sh, I01) instead. ISA: the D1 goldens (tests/planning/test_registry.py, registry_golden.json) were recorded on the AVX2 reference host; on an AVX-512 host (dmax) the numpy SIMD dispatch and the OpenBLAS kernels take other paths and the result digests differ (C-41: byte reproducibility holds within one ISA), so the step pins numpy to X86_V3 and OpenBLAS to the Haswell kernels (no-ops on the AVX2 host). Deselected, each covered by another gate step that has the inputs: the TS generator check and the JS lint self-test need the npm node_modules (contracts and lint steps), the make demo case needs the front-end production build (public-build and public-e2e steps), the make dry-run parse needs make (contracts, lint and the other make steps parse the Makefile)

public_e2e.doc: AWR-04 §13 cgroup emulation of emax: unit CPUQuota 250 %, MemoryHigh 1.8G, MemoryMax 2G, cpuset 0-3, cgroup-exec.sh subgroups; supervisor with the shared show S7 and the sandbox control plane (quota profile local: one loopback visitor; prefix quota and proof of work are covered by the D2 sandbox tests); browser on client_cpus; the site routes like the emax nginx, the /lab/ build mounted at /lab/ when present

tier_s.doc: ttfp_ms_max = thresholds.json ttfp_ms (D1-AC-02, frozen); regress_max = the 5 % of D3-AC-01; regress_floor_ms = timing resolution of the shared local host for a TTFP of about 10 ms

perf.doc: D3-AC-01 item 3 (AWR-05 §4.8): targets/perception budget cases of D2 (M18-AC-022, M19-AC-010, M19-AC-026). Each repeat is a fresh worker process; metrics are the thread CPU time of the call phase (call_cpu_ms; preemption and run-queue waits of a loaded host are excluded) and the record_property values of the case; median of `repeats` after `warmup` (7 rather than the 3 of ADR-033: single repeats spread 10-40 % on the shared CPU pool), each <= D2 baseline x (1 + max_regression); the baseline is the median of `baseline_repeats` (a single 5-repeat session drifts about 3 % between sessions). Outcomes must equal the D2 baseline (cases that passed on d2 must pass; D2 budget misses stay accepted only while identical). Baseline: baseline.json `perf`, recorded with the d2@928c57b awr package on the dmax CPU pool in a no-load window; host fingerprint (CPU model, Python, numpy, numba) must match. flight60 and fleet-ladder are not part of this step yet
